newsitem.title: UK: Brown to phase release of local authority receipts.
newsitem.headline: Brown to phase release of local authority receipts.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Wednesday he would phase the release of capital receipts from local authority housing in order to create decent housing at affordable rents.

"I can...announce the first step in a practical and measured programme to phase the release of capital receipts in a practical and measured programme to phase the release of capital receipts," Brown told parliament.

"Local authorities will have borrowing consents for an additional 900 million pounds -- 200 million this year and 700 million next year -- for building new houses and repairing their existing stock," he said.
